cards.ex: Now that I'm free from obligation, I can finally travel.
cards.exUz: Endi men majburiyatlardan ozod bo'lganimdan keyin, nihoyat sayohat qila olaman.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday majburiyat yoki vazifa yuklanmagan holat.

cards.ex: The president decided to grant amnesty to several political prisoners.
cards.exUz: Prezident bir nechta siyosiy mahbuslarga amnistiya berishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kechirish, ayniqsa siyosiy mahbuslarni ozod qilish.

cards.ex: The CEO will be held accountable for the company's financial losses.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktor kompaniyaning moliyaviy yo'qotishlari uchun javobgar bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: O'z harakatlari uchun javob berishga majbur bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The details of the negotiation were kept under wraps.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar tafsilotlari sir saqlandi.
cards.uzDef: Maxfiy saqlanadigan, oshkor qilinmaydigan holat.

cards.ex: If you want to keep your job, you'll have to toe the line.
cards.exUz: Agar ishingizni saqlab qolmoqchi bo'lsangiz, qoidalarga rioya qilishingiz kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Belgilangan qoidalarga qat'iy rioya qilish.

cards.ex: The company faces several legal constraints due to environmental regulations.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya atrof-muhit qoidalariga bog'liq bir nechta huquqiy cheklovlarga duch kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qonun bilan o'rnatilgan cheklov yoki to'siq.

cards.ex: The country is trying to shake off the restrictions imposed by the trade embargo.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat savdo embargosi tomonidan qo'yilgan cheklovlardan qutulishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Cheklovlardan xalos bo'lishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The manager can decide at his discretion whether to approve the request.
cards.exUz: Menejer so'rovni tasdiqlash yoki tasdiqlamaslikni o'z ixtiyorida hal qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: O'z qarori asosida, erkin tanlash huquqi bilan.

cards.ex: The project suffered limitations due to budget cuts.
cards.exUz: Loyiha byudjet qisqarishi tufayli cheklovlarga duch keldi.
cards.uzDef: Imkoniyatlari yoki harakatlari cheklangan bo'lish.

cards.ex: The law carves out exceptions for certain types of businesses.
cards.exUz: Qonun muayyan turdagi bizneslar uchun istisnolar yaratadi.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalardan alohida holatlar uchun istisnolar yaratish.

cards.ex: Journalists need untrammelled access to information to do their job effectively.
cards.exUz: Jurnalistlar o'z ishlarini samarali bajarish uchun ma'lumotga cheklanmagan kirish huquqiga ega bo'lishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday to'siqsiz yoki cheklovsiz kirish imkoniyati.

cards.ex: The government came under fire for its restrictive immigration policies.
cards.exUz: Hukumat immigratsiya bo'yicha cheklovchi siyosati uchun tanqidga uchradi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq tanqidga uchramoq, hujumga uchrash.

cards.ex: His anger was held in check with great difficulty.
cards.exUz: Uning g'azabi katta qiyinchilik bilan nazoratda ushlab turildi.
cards.uzDef: Nazorat qilinadigan, cheklangan holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The artist is known for pushing the envelope with her controversial performances.
cards.exUz: Rassom o'zining bahsli chiqishlari bilan chegaradan chiqishi bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagidan tashqari, yangi chegaralarni sinab ko'rish.

cards.ex: After winning the lottery, he decided to live life large.
cards.exUz: Lotereyada yutgandan so'ng, u keng hayot kechirishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Hashamatli va quvonchli hayot kechirish.

cards.ex: Bureaucracy can hamper progress and innovation.
cards.exUz: Byurokratiya taraqqiyot va innovatsiyalarga to'sqinlik qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Rivojlanish yoki taraqqiyotga xalaqit berish.

cards.ex: Her unbridled enthusiasm for the project was contagious.
cards.exUz: Uning loyihaga bo'lgan cheklanmagan ishtiyoqi yuqumli edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta va nazorat qilinmaydigan ishtiyoq.

cards.ex: He managed to escape the clutches of the criminal gang.
cards.exUz: U jinoiy guruh qo'lidan qutulishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki qiyin vaziyatdan qutulmoq.

cards.ex: The constitution is meant to circumscribe the power of the president.
cards.exUz: Konstitutsiya prezidentning hokimiyatini cheklash uchun mo'ljallangan.
cards.uzDef: Hukumat yoki hokimiyatning kuchini cheklash.

cards.ex: She felt like she was living in a gilded cage, despite her wealth.
cards.exUz: U boyligiga qaramay, o'zini oltin qafasda yashayotgandek his qildi.
cards.uzDef: Tashqi tomondan yaxshi, ammo aslida erkinlik yo'q.

cards.ex: The project came unstuck because of a lack of funding.
cards.exUz: Loyiha mablag' etishmasligi sababli muammoga duch keldi.
cards.uzDef: Reja ishlamay qolishi, muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrash.

cards.ex: The government is cutting discretionary spending to reduce the budget deficit.
cards.exUz: Hukumat byudjet taqchilligini kamaytirish uchun ixtiyoriy xarajatlarni qisqartirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Majburiy bo'lmagan, ixtiyoriy ravishda qilinadigan xarajatlar.

cards.ex: The company rode roughshod over local residents in its pursuit of profit.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya foyda olish maqsadida mahalliy aholini mensimasdan harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarning huquqlarini mensimasdan, shafqatsizlarcha harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: The country needed to break the shackles of its colonial past.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat o'zining mustamlakachilik o'tmishining kishanlarini yechishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Cheklovlar va to'siqlardan xalos bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The negotiator had very little room to maneuver in the talks.
cards.exUz: Muzokarachining muzokaralarda harakat qilish uchun juda kam imkoniyati bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yaxshilash uchun harakat qilish erkinligi.

cards.ex: The artist felt bound by convention and struggled to express his true self.
cards.exUz: Rassom o'zini an'analar bilan bog'langan deb his qildi va o'zligini ifoda etishga qiynaldi.
cards.uzDef: An'analar, urf-odatlar yoki kelishuvlar bilan cheklangan.

cards.ex: Taxes are often seen as a necessary evil for funding public services.
cards.exUz: Soliqlar ko'pincha davlat xizmatlarini moliyalashtirish uchun zarur yomonlik deb hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Yoqimsiz, lekin erishish uchun kerak bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The dictator ruled with impunity for many years.
cards.exUz: Diktator ko'p yillar davomida jazosiz hukmronlik qildi.
cards.uzDef: Jazolanmasdan, jazosiz qolgan holda.

cards.ex: The company needed to reach escape velocity to become a market leader.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya bozor yetakchisiga aylanishi uchun qochish tezligiga erishishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Tortishish kuchidan qutulish uchun zarur bo'lgan tezlik.

cards.ex: She signed the contract under duress, fearing for her family's safety.
cards.exUz: U oilasining xavfsizligidan qo'rqib, shartnomani majburan imzoladi.
cards.uzDef: Bosim ostida, majburlash natijasida.
